question: What initial practice is undertaken first in relation to the root wheel?
premises: The practice is described as first.
The root wheel is the object of practice.
The beloved is addressed at the time of practice.
inference: The first stage is the practice directed to the root wheel.
uncertainties: The fused token yadānyabhyasate is analyzed without splitting the surface.
plain_english: O beloved, first, when one practices upon the root wheel.
